[attribute-description]
=== `@description` Private Character Description

Human-readable description of a defined private character (for example, “`Arrow, normal weight, single line, two-headed, Northwest to Southeast`”).

#### Usage/Remarks
The <<attribute-name,`@name`>> attribute for a defined private character <<element-private-char,`<private-char>`>> provides a Unicode-style name (an all uppercase name) for the private character, for example, “`COMBINING CYRILLIC PALATALIZATION`”. In contrast, the <<attribute-description,`@description`>> attribute for a defined private character <<element-private-char,`<private-char>`>> provides a rough visual description, for example, “`combining vertical tilde`”.

#### OPTIONAL on element:  <<element-private-char,`<private-char>`>>

|===
| Value| Meaning

| Text, numbers, or special characters| A rough visual description of the appearance of the <<element-private-char,`<private-char>`>> character, for example,
                        “`Greek capital letter omega with tonos`”.
| Restriction| This is an optional attribute; there is no default.
|===
